question: Which retirement system's investment consultant RFP requires firms to certify that they currently provide investment consulting services to clients whose combined assets total at least $50 billion?
gold_answer: Teachers' Retirement System of the State of Illinois (TRS Illinois), in its FY23 investment consultant RFP (Appendix B, Statement of Minimum Qualifications).
acceptance: TRS Illinois / Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois is sufficient; FY23 and appendix identifier are optional.
candidate_answer: The **Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois (TRS)**. Its investment consultant RFP lists the $50 billion combined-client-assets requirement in Appendix B, “Statement of Minimum Qualifications” (p. 13).
